newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plains cattle bid at $67, passed - feedlots.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plains cattle bid at $67, passed - feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle were bid lightly at $67.00 per cwt, about steady with the bulk of last week's sales, with owners pricing cattle at $69.00 to $70.00, feedlot sources said.
Cattle sold in direct trade at $67.00 last week with a few sold late at $68.00, USDA confirmed.
Cattle values were seen buoyed by smaller supplies of market -ready cattle and outlooks for further gains in beef prices.
Brisk sales last week and talk that cold, wet weather had hampered weight gains in Nebraska and Kansas were seen trimming this week's showlists, cattle feeders said.
